target_metadata.target_name: SARS-CoV-2 positivity rate among department influenza-like illness (ILI) cases
target_metadata.description: This target represents the SARS-CoV-2 positivity rate among department influenza-like illness (ILI) cases, as reported in China CDCs weekly National Sentinel Surveillance of Acute Respiratory Infectious Diseases, in the week ending on the target_end_date (i.e., [horizon] weeks after the reference_date).

target_metadata.target_name: Influenza virus positivity rate among department influenza-like illness (ILI) cases
target_metadata.description: This target represents the influenza virus positivity rate among department influenza-like illness (ILI) cases, as reported in China CDCs weekly National Sentinel Surveillance of Acute Respiratory Infectious Diseases, in the week ending on the target_end_date (i.e., [horizon] weeks after the reference_date).

This target represents the number of reported dengue cases in China, as published in China CDCs monthly notifiable infectious disease surveillance report, in the calendar month starting on the target_end_date (i.e., [horizon] months after the reference_date).
